67.subtopic: Position, Electronic Configuration and General Features of d-Block
67.stemOverride: Identify false statement about transition elements.

optionOverrides.A: These exhibit properties between those of \(s\) and \(p\) block elements.
optionOverrides.B: All these elements are grouped as 3d to 6d series.
optionOverrides.C: 5d series is comprised of all elements from La \((Z = 57)\) to Hg \((Z = 80)\).
optionOverrides.D: Elements of 6d series belong to the \(7^{\text{th}}\) period of the periodic table.

67.solution: The 5d series runs from La \((Z = 57)\) and then Hf \((Z = 72)\) to Hg \((Z = 80)\). The lanthanoids, Ce to Lu \((Z = 58\) to \(71)\), fill 4f orbitals and are not part of it. So statement C is false; A, B and D are true. Option C.

68.solution: In a haloalkyne the halogen is bonded directly to an sp carbon of the triple bond. Only in D is X on a \(\text{C}\equiv\text{C}\) carbon. A is a vinylic halide, B is propargylic and in C the halogen is on an sp3 carbon. Option D.
